title: Judge Gift Cards 2016: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Power is wasted on the weak. They never keep it for long." —Nicol Bolas
"I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest." —Riku of Two Reflections
"If Heaven has placed it in your hands, it means that the throne is destined to be yours."
Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.
